description: This file defines a Java interface for mapping scenarios that convert a Ditto Adaptable object into an external message, serving as a contract for implementing specific protocol scenarios.

classes.name: MapFromDittoProtocolScenario
classes.description: An interface defining the contract for protocol scenario mappings from a Ditto Adaptable to a message.

methods.name: getMessageMapper
methods.description: Returns the MessageMapper associated with the scenario.

methods.name: getDittoAdaptable
methods.description: Returns the Ditto Adaptable involved in the scenario.
